channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: In Your Community: A brush with history
item.description: At the 2026 Commodity Classic, Corteva’s booth showcased an original Pioneer seed truck, letting visitors like Gene and Dorene Anderson experience a piece of seed company history.

item.title: SWCD seeks internship applicants
item.description: Mower SWCD seeks paid summer intern for hands-on conservation work in Mower County; college applications due by noon March 20.

item.title: Discounted rain barrels offered again locally
item.description: Mower County offers $50 rain barrels and $50 compost bins, with Austin Utilities customers getting a $10 rebate. Order online now for April 24 pickup at Mower County Recycling Center.

item.title: Convictions: Feb. 23-March 2
item.description: Recent convictions from Feb. 23–March 2: probation, fines and jail time handed down in local cases involving firearms, DWI, burglary, property damage and other offenses.

item.title: Some Minnesota farmers are on edge as drought conditions creep through the state
item.description: With two-thirds of Minnesota abnormally dry, farmers balance short-term benefits of dry fields with concern about deepening drought and uncertain spring rains.

item.title: Freedom Fest to reach new heights with 2026 celebration
item.description: Freedom Fest 2026 adds 300-drone sky show, lumberjack acts and Ninja Anywhere as Austin Enhancement Group gears up for America’s 250th celebration.

item.title: Bruins can't hold on after fast start
item.description: Austin jumps ahead 3-1 on EJ Paddington’s pair, but Aberdeen answers with five straight goals to hand the Bruins a 6-3 road loss.

item.title: Rebels use one-two punch to knock out Vikings in Section 1A semifinals, will take aim for program’s first state berth
item.description: Top-seeded Southland crushed Hayfield 76-37 in the Section 1A semifinals behind Henry Wiste’s 39 points and Tate Goergen’s 25, earning a shot Thursday at the program’s first state tournament berth.

item.title: Packers play with passion, close out Tigers to advance to Section 1AAA title game
item.description: No. 2 Austin rallies past No. 3 Stewartville 75-66 at Ove Berven Gym in a packed Section 1AAA semifinal, led by Cole Hebrink and J'dan Stevens, to reach the section title game.

item.title: Bruins beat Wings to stay tied for NAHL Central lead
item.description: EJ Paddington’s two first-period goals and Jack Solomon’s 31 saves lifted the Austin Bruins to a 3-2 win over Aberdeen, keeping them tied with Bismarck atop the NAHL Central at 72 points.
